title: A/B Test Analysis Compiler
description: Compiles A/B test analysis scripts. Enforces treatment/control definition, pre-calculated sample sizes, randomization verification, single primary metric, guardrail metrics, significance and power settings, and correct interpretation (no p-hacking).

error_codes.AB002: Treatment and control groups not clearly defined
error_codes.AB003: Sample size not pre-calculated — test may be underpowered or overrun
error_codes.AB005: Multiple primary metrics defined — choose exactly one primary metric to avoid p-hacking
error_codes.AB006: No guardrail metrics defined to detect regressions
error_codes.AB007: Significance level (α) or statistical power (β) not set
